sections.title: They forgot who they work for.
notes: The people are the employer. The 535 are the hire.
The Constitution does not open with Congress. It opens with three words: We the People. The people are the employer, and the 535 are the hire.
This journal prints the record. No network, no manufactured drama. Government sources only. Compare the action to the speech. That is the first step.
Vote the file. Not the feeling.

From the original edition, restored as written. Figures that changed since are shown at today’s values: 263 cases in the catalog (129 verified, 131 still being checked, 3 set aside); national debt $40.07T (Treasury, Debt to the Penny, Sep 24, 2026).

Swamp Force is a journal of record. I publish the laws and official files anyone can open. I provide what is on the record: the facts of actions taken by our representatives. I do not write a narrative.

It is not what we say that defines us. It is what we do. Form your own opinions from the actions taken, not from the words spoken. This journal records what was done, not statements cut out of context.

Unless I specifically mark a passage as my opinion, treat what is written here as the record. I am a fellow American, loyal to no party. If a number is wrong or a page breaks, write editor@swampforce.com. Any peaceful person who wants a correction, or a subject placed on the table, will get that work. I will research what the record requires.
